mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, username, action, target_type, target_id, request_method, request_path, request_ip, user_agent, request_id, result_code, success, error_message, before_data, after_data, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{requestMethod}, #{requestPath}, #{requestIp}, #{userAgent}, #{requestId}, #{resultCode}, #{success}, #{errorMessage}, #{beforeData}, #{afterData}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT log_id, user_id, username, action, target_type, target_id, request_method, request_path, request_ip, user_agent, request_id, result_code, success, error_message, before_data, after_data, created_at FROM audit_log ORDER BY created_at DESC, log_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
